description: Source code implementing conversions between C++ and NDK parcelable types for Android media audio, including template functions for general and enum conversions, and generated converter functions for specific media audio types.

methods.name: cpp2ndk
methods.description: Converts a C++ type to its NDK parcelable equivalent using marshaling.

methods.name: ndk2cpp
methods.description: Converts an NDK parcelable type to its C++ equivalent using unmarshaling.

methods.name: convertEnum
methods.description: Converts enum values between different representations with range validation.

methods.name: cpp2ndk_Enum
methods.description: Efficient conversion of enums from C++ to NDK representation.

methods.name: ndk2cpp_Enum
methods.description: Efficient conversion of enums from NDK to C++ representation.
